∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                    ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                      have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                      (Measurable fun z => outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∧
                        (∀ᵐ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) ∂P,
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch →
                              ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch j).isSome = true) ∧
                          ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                            MeasurableSet E →
                              (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                ∀ (v : Fin q.S → Fin q.m),
                                  P
                                      (E ∩
                                        {z |
                                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch = fun j =>
                                            some (v j)}) =
                                    P E * (↑q.m ^ q.S)⁻¹

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)),
      0 < labels.length →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
          (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          Measurable rows →
            (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
              (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n labels x start rows answer →
                  ∀ (j : Fin n) (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                          ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.couponWaiting n labels x start (rows ω)
                              (fun a r => answer a r ω) j u) ∂↑P ≤
                        1 + ↑(min (↑j + 1) labels.length) / ↑u

    (List.filterMap (fun i => Option.map (fun job => some job.component) (pending i))
            (List.filter (fun i => decide (i ≤ j)) (List.finRange n))).length ≤
        (List.filter (fun i => decide (i ≤ j)) (List.finRange n)).length →
      (List.filter (fun i => decide (i ≤ j)) (List.finRange n)).length = ↑j + 1 →
        (List.map (fun a => labels[a]?) rem).length = rem.length →
          ¬rem.length ≤ (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.uncovered labels rem pending j).length + (↑j + 1) → False

            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchResult q O seed ω batch =
                    (↑q.S)⁻¹ •
                      ∑ j,
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j).elim 0 fun i =>
                          gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y

  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                  ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                        ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          have error := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchError q f O batch;
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable error P ∧
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖error z‖ ^ 2) P ∧
                              ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                                MeasurableSet E →
                                  (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                    ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                          error z ∂P =
                                        0 ∧
                                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                          ‖error z‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
                                        Lpm ^ 2 / ↑q.S *
                                          ∫ (z :
                                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                                            ‖(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchInputs q O z.1 z.2 batch).1 -
                                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchInputs q O z.1 z.2 batch).2‖ ^
                                              2 ∂P

          (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →

              (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.fullResult
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer (n * m)) =
                  gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
          Monotone τ →
            ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
              Measurable rows →
                (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
                  (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer →
                      (Measurable fun ω =>
                          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                              (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock) ∧
                        ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                            ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                                    (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock -
                                start) ∂↑P ≤
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ m

∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        ∀ (a : ℕ),
          have s := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer a;
          s.remaining.Nodup ∧
            (∀ b ∈ s.remaining, b < labels.length) ∧
              start ≤ s.clock ∧
                s.sum + (List.map (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.contribution f labels x) s.remaining).sum =
                    (List.map (fun i => gradient (f i) x) labels).sum ∧
                  (s.remaining ≠ [] →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.legalRequest τ { clock := s.clock, pending := s.pending }) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin n) (job : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → job.kind = Sum.inl x ∧ job.id < s.nextID) ∧
                      ∀ (i i' : Fin n) (job job' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → s.pending i' = some job' → job.id = job'.id → i = i'

∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.fullResult
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)) =
          (↑labels.length)⁻¹ • (List.map (fun i => gradient (f i) x) labels).sum

declarations.type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  ∀ (γ : outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.BatchSchedule q.n),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.ScheduleRealization q f τ O seed ω batch γ →
                      have callStart := (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchStartCall q O seed ω batch).getD 0;
                      (Function.Injective fun j =>
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            Option.map (fun job => job.id)
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedJob q O seed ω batch j) =
                              some (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)) ∧
                          ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j =
                              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchLabels q seed batch
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                    MeasurableSet E →
                      (∀ z ∈ E,
                          ∃ x y clock firstID,
                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                              some (false, x, y, clock, firstID)) →
                        have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                        ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                            ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                          4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.S * P E

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                    MeasurableSet E →
                      (∀ z ∈ E,
                          ∃ x clock firstID,
                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                              some (true, x, x, clock, firstID)) →
                        have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                        ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                            ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ q.m * P E

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample q.m q.n →
            ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal),
              Monotone τ →
                ∀
                  (O :
                    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                    ∀ (batch : ℕ) (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                      MeasurableSet E →
                        (∀ z ∈ E,
                            ∃ x clock firstID,
                              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch =
                                some (true, x, x, clock, firstID)) →
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,
                              ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∂P ≤
                            5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑q.m * P E

            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (z.2 a)) →

                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O z.1 z.2 batch = some (full, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchEndCall q O z.1 z.2 batch).isSome = true ∧
                    (if full = true then
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace q.n (List.ofFn id) 0 0
                            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartedRows q O batch z)
                            (fun a r => outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartAnswer q O batch a r z)
                            (q.n * q.m)).clock
                      else
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace q.n q.S 0 0 0
                            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartedRows q O batch z)
                            (fun a r => outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.restartAnswer q O batch a r z)
                            q.S).clock) =
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaConditionalCosts.batchElapsed q O z.1 z.2 batch

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw)
  (O :
    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
  (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)
  (c : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.FullState q.d q.m q.n),
  0 <
      (fun c =>
          if c.remaining = [] then 0
          else
            q.n * (c.remaining.length + 1) -
              {i | ∃ job, c.pending i = some job ∧ ∃ b ∈ c.remaining, c.original[b]? = some job.component}.card)
        c →
    outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q +
          ((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q -
                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.trace q O seed ω (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q)).iteration) *
              max (q.n * q.m) q.S +
            (fun c =>
                if c.remaining = [] then 0
                else
                  q.n * (c.remaining.length + 1) -
                    {i | ∃ job, c.pending i = some job ∧ ∃ b ∈ c.remaining, c.original[b]? = some job.component}.card)
              c) ≤
        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q →
      ∀ (p a b : ℕ), False

        n ≤ n * s.remaining.length →
          ¬0 <
                n * s.remaining.length + n -
                  ((fun s => {i | ∃ job, s.pending i = some job ∧ ∃ b ∈ s.remaining, labels[b]? = some job.component})
                      s).card →
            False

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw)
  (O :
    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
  (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)
  (c : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.FullState q.d q.m q.n),
  0 <
      (fun c =>
          if c.remaining = [] then 0
          else
            q.n * (c.remaining.length + 1) -
              {i | ∃ job, c.pending i = some job ∧ ∃ b ∈ c.remaining, c.original[b]? = some job.component}.card)
        c →
    outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q +
          ((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.rounds q -
                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.trace q O seed ω (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q)).iteration) *
              max (q.n * q.m) q.S +
            (fun c =>
                if c.remaining = [] then 0
                else
                  q.n * (c.remaining.length + 1) -
                    {i | ∃ job, c.pending i = some job ∧ ∃ b ∈ c.remaining, c.original[b]? = some job.component}.card)
              c) ≤
        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q →
      ∀ (p a b : ℕ), False

            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (N : ℕ),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →

                      (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.prefix q) (fun x => N) seed ω).1 ∧
                    (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.prefix q) (fun x => N) seed ω).2 ≤

  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 < p.S →
        0 < p.ρ →
          p.ρ ≤ 1 →
            0 ≤ p.Lminus →
              0 ≤ p.Lpm →
                0 ≤ p.Δ →
                  0 < p.ε →
                    0 < outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyCoefficient p.toBase p.S p.ρ →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample p.m p.n →
                        ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ) (lower Lplus : ℝ),
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f p.x0 lower p.Lminus Lplus p.Lpm p.Δ →
                            ∀ (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                              Monotone τ →
                                ∀
                                  (O :
                                    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
                                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
                                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent
                                        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true) f τ O →
                                      ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit
                                              (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true) ≤
                                            N →
                                          let q := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true;
                                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                          have out := fun z =>
                                            OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q)
                                              (fun x => N) z.1 z.2;
                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                              (fun z =>
                                                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2)
                                              P ∧
                                            ∫ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
                                                p.ε ∧
                                              ∫⁻ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
                                                12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                                  ENNReal.ofReal
                                                      (48 * p.Δ / p.ε *
                                                        (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * √((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * ↑p.S)))) *
                                                    (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ *
                                                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                                      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p.ρ) *
                                                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.S)

declarations.type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              0 < q.η →
                ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ Lminus →
                    0 ≤ Lpm →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                        q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * √((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * ↑q.S))) →
                          ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                            (O :
                              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                                    have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                    have accuracy := fun z =>
                                      ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                            (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q)
                                                (fun x => N) z.1 z.2).1‖ ^
                                        2;
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable accuracy P ∧
                                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                            accuracy z ∂P ≤
                                          2 * (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ↑q.K) ∧
                                        ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                                          0 < ε →
                                            2 * (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ε) ≤
                                                ↑q.K →
                                              ∫ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  accuracy z ∂P ≤
                                                ε

∀ {d m : ℕ} {f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ} {x0 : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d}
  {lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
    (∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →
      (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
          ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x - gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ≤
            Lminus * ‖x - y‖) →
        (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
            (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
          (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
              (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -
                  ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                        gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                    2 ≤
                Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ →
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ

{d m : ℕ} →
  {f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ} →
    {x0 : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
      {lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ} →
        {motive : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ → Sort u} →
          ((differentiable : ∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
              (lower_bound :
                  ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →
                (smooth :
                    ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                      ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                            gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ≤
                        Lminus * ‖x - y‖) →
                  (mean_square :
                      ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                        (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                    (centered :
                        ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                          (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -
                              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x -
                                    gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                                2 ≤
                            Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                      (gap : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ) → motive ⋯) →
            (t : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ) → motive t

                (lower_bound :
                    ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), lower ≤ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x) →

                        ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                          (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lplus ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →

                          ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d),
                            (↑m)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ^ 2 -

                                      gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) y‖ ^
                                  2 ≤
                              Lpm ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2) →
                        (gap : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f x0 - lower ≤ Δ) → motive ⋯) →
              motive t

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.S →
      0 < q.ρ →
        q.ρ ≤ 1 →
          0 < q.η →
            ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
              0 ≤ Lminus →
                0 ≤ Lpm →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                    q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * √((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * ↑q.S))) →
                      ∀ k < q.K,
                        ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.energy q f z
                              (k + 1) ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ≤
                          ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaSerialAnalysis.energy q f z
                                k ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) -
                            q.η / 2 *
                              ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z k).1‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q)

∀ {d : ℕ} (f : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ),
  Differentiable ℝ f →
    ∀ (L : ℝ),
      0 ≤ L →
        (∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
          ∀ (x v : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (η : ℝ),
            0 < η →
              f (x - η • v) ≤
                f x - η / 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 - (1 / (2 * η) - L / 2) * ‖η • v‖ ^ 2 + η / 2 * ‖v - gradient f x‖ ^ 2

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.SerialRaw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.S →
      0 < q.K →
        0 < q.ρ →
          q.ρ ≤ 1 →
            0 < q.η →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                0 ≤ Lminus →
                  0 ≤ Lpm →
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                      q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * √((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * ↑q.S))) →
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable
                            (fun z =>
                              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                    (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput q f z)‖ ^
                                2)
                            ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ∧
                          ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.CanonicalSeed q),
                              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                    (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealOutput q f z)‖ ^
                                2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q) ≤
                            2 * (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ↑q.K)

                      (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.idealTrace q f z ↑k).1‖ ^
                  2 ∂↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaSerial.canonicalLaw q)

                        ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),

                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),

                                        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p false) ≤
                                      N →

                                                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyCoefficient p.toBase p.S p.ρ /
                                              p.ε) *
                                          (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +

  (p.Δ = 0 ∨ p.Lminus = 0 →

        p.Lminus ≠ 0 →
          outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized p =

      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m = 0 ∨ outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m = ⊤ →
          outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedProbability p = 1) ∧
        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedRaw p).S = outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p ∧
          (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedRaw p).ρ = outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedProbability p ∧

              (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedRaw p).K = outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedHorizon p

declarations.type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.Params),
  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimized (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageOptimizedTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * √↑p.m) / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        ∫⁻ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)), ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
          12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m +
            ENNReal.ofReal (96 * p.Δ / p.ε) *
              ⨅ S,
                min (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m)
                  (ENNReal.ofReal p.Lminus * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (↑↑S + 1) +
                    ENNReal.ofReal p.Lpm *
                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m *
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (↑↑S + 1) /
                          (↑↑S + 1)) ^
                        (1 / 2))

  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2) P ∧
          ∫ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
              ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
            p.ε

∀ (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.Params),
  outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.spec.admissible p f O →
        have A := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simple (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageSimpleTime.publicInput p);
        have P := (↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1);
        have out := fun z =>
          OracleTemplate.execute O A (fun x => p.n * p.m * (⌈4 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε⌉₊ + 2)) z.1 z.2;
        ∫⁻ (z : A.Seed 1 × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)), ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
          12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ ↑p.m +
            ENNReal.ofReal (192 * p.Δ * max p.Lminus p.Lpm / p.ε) *
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime p.τ (ENNReal.ofReal √↑p.m)
